name: resizable
title: Resizable
description: Panels that share a seam you can move, on react-resizable-panels v4: the 1px seam is the handle, thickening to 3px ink on hover or drag and drawn in the focus colour on keyboard focus; an optional grip cell. Keys, collapse, reset, touch targets and persistence are the library's.
whenToUse: Use it for panes that share a seam the reader can move or collapse. Put it in a Panel or an App shell column; for a fixed layout use App shell alone.

parts.name: ResizablePanelGroup
parts.description: Resizable (on react-resizable-panels v4 since the round-20 review): panels that share a seam you can move. The library owns the behaviour: the separator's ARIA (value, bounds, controls), arrows, Home/End, Enter to collapse, double-click to reset, pointer and touch hit targets, layout persistence (`useDefaultLayout`) and the imperative API (`groupRef`, `panelRef`: collapse, expand, resize). Keyline only draws it. - Sizes follow the library: numbers are pixels, strings are percentages ("30%" or "30"). - Name each separator (`aria-label`) after the panel it resizes. - Dragging needs a pointer alternative (WCAG 2.5.7): double-click resets the layout; for collapse, give the page a button that calls `panelRef.current.collapse()` / `.expand()`. - No frame of its own: put it in a Panel body, a shell column or any frame.
